verdict.rationale: The only scheduling evidence is "scheduled Deep scans" in the enterprise tier, which is a fixed recurring security-scan feature rather than user-defined recurring jobs or workflows. The built-in backend includes edge functions, but nothing in the pack says they can run on a cron or schedule. Missing for 10: user-configurable scheduled/cron jobs, recurring workflow automation, documentation of scheduling edge functions or agent tasks, and any hands-on corroboration.
